title: VideoAutoArena: An Automated Arena for Evaluating Large Multimodal Models in Video Analysis through User Simulation

live_model.evidence: "In our experiments, we evaluate 11 SOTA LMMs: 1. gpt-4o-2024-05-13, 2. gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 ..." (Appendix B.2); Table 3 GPT-4o vs Sel. 70.98, vs Rej. 94.12, Avg. 82.55

prompt.location: Appendix A, Figures 10-14 (persona generation, question asking, evolution, judging, complexity prompts)

claim.metric: VideoAutoBench average score vs human-selected/rejected answers

data.source: videos from LongVideoBench/VideoMME sources; generated questions and human-selected answers on the project page (https://videoautoarena.github.io/)

notes: Judge, user simulator and evolution model are gpt-4o-2024-08-06, which is not in the project's live list. Video input (up to 64 frames at 512x512 per response) makes cost high; number of battles in VideoAutoBench is not stated (about 300 human-annotated battles).
